user_story: As a customer on https://www.saucedemo.com, I want to add and remove a product from my cart so that the cart badge stays accurate. Acceptance criteria: after logging in with 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', clicking [data-test="add-to-cart-sauce-labs-backpack"] makes the cart badge '.shopping_cart_badge' show '1' and the button label change to 'Remove'; clicking [data-test="remove-sauce-labs-backpack"] removes the badge from the page.
